info.name: Brightloop Software - Subscription Management System API
info.description:
API collection for Brightloop Subscription Management System:
- Module 1: Authentication & Role Management
- Module 2: Product & Product Variant Management
- Part 1: Quotations & Subscription Lifecycles
- Part 2: Tax, Discount, Invoice, Payment & Financial Reporting

request.description: Registers a new customer. Automatically assigns the CUSTOMER role.

exec: console.log("Saved JWT access token to collection variable.");

request.description: Admin only. Creates a new core product.

request.description: Creates a new subscription plan with lifecycle policies and billing intervals.
Retrieves comprehensive subscription plan details including associated product/variant and lifecycle audit trail.
Partially updates an existing subscription plan. Closed plans cannot be updated.
Transitions an ACTIVE plan to PAUSED status. Only valid if allow_pause=true.
Transitions a PAUSED plan back to ACTIVE status.
Transitions a plan permanently to CLOSED status. Requires allow_early_closure or passed availability window. Cannot be undone.
Returns full chronological audit log of all status transitions for the plan.
Deletes a subscription plan.
Returns paginated list of reusable quotation templates with bundled products, variants, and plans.
Creates a reusable quotation template. Admin & Staff only.
Returns active customer accounts for selection during quotation creation. Admin & Staff only.
Lists quotations. Staff and Admin see all quotations; Customer users only see their own.
Creates a customer quotation taking immutable price and tax snapshots. Initial status is DRAFT.
Returns quotation specifications, pricing snapshot, line items, and email dispatch history.
Transitions quotation status from DRAFT to QUOTATION (Issued). Admin and Staff only.
Customer, Staff or Admin confirms quotation acceptance. Makes quotation eligible for subscription conversion.
Cancels a DRAFT or QUOTATION status quotation.
Generates and streams high-resolution ReportLab PDF with brand header, line item table, pricing and signature blocks.
Attaches ReportLab PDF and dispatches quotation email to recipient, logging dispatch history.
Returns immutable status change audit trail for the quotation.
Atomically converts a CONFIRMED quotation into an operational Subscription with copied price snapshots and next billing date calculation. Prevents duplicate conversions.
Lists subscriptions. Filterable by status (ACTIVE, CONFIRMED, CLOSED) and is_paused boolean.
Returns full subscription record, items, pause operational history, and renewal history.
Activates a CONFIRMED subscription, commencing billing intervals.
Pauses an active subscription and logs pause history with mandatory reason.
Resumes a paused subscription, closing the pause history record and restoring active status.
Creates a new renewed subscription linked via SubscriptionRenewal to the previous subscription.
Permanently terminates a subscription.
Returns status transition audit trail for the subscription.
Returns linked previous and subsequent subscription renewal contracts.
Lists all active and statutory tax rules.
Creates a statutory tax configuration.
Lists promotional discount campaigns and coupons.
Creates a promotional discount rule with usage limits.
Deactivates a discount rule or coupon.
Lists invoices filtered by status, overdue, or customer.
Generates a cycle tax invoice for an active subscription.
Retrieves full invoice details with line items and email logs.
Confirms a draft invoice and makes it payable.
Cancels an invoice.
Downloads branded ReportLab vector PDF.
Sends vector PDF invoice attached via email.
Returns unpaid invoices past their due date.
Triggers recurring billing engine across all due subscriptions.
Returns audit history of automated billing engine cycles.
Audit list of all payments and settlements.

item.name: Record Offline Payment (Cash / Bank Transfer / UPI)

request.description: Records manual offline settlement and reconciles invoice balance.
Creates Razorpay order for online payment.
Validates HMAC SHA256 signature and marks invoice paid.
Real-time KPIs for MRR, revenue collected, receivables, and churn.
Exports monthly revenue breakdown as CSV.
Exports tax invoices ledger as CSV.
Exports payment transactions ledger as CSV.
Exports active subscriptions overview as CSV.
